inAppEventProposal.name: Semester Kickoff Week
inAppEventProposal.shortDescription: Build a calm, reviewed semester plan.
inAppEventProposal.longDescription: Import a syllabus, approve each deadline, and finish your first-week plan before classes ramp up.
inAppEventProposal.productTruthCondition: Use CHALLENGE only while the app tracks progress toward completing first-week setup during the event window.

featuringNominationProposal.name: Back-to-School Semester Kickoff
featuringNominationProposal.description: Study Planner AI helps students turn the first stack of syllabi into a calm plan they control. Students scan or import class material, review detected courses, assignments, exams, and uncertain dates, then approve every deadline before anything is saved. Build 82 adds user-controlled System, Light, and Dark appearance with white-and-black app chrome while course colors stay distinct and native widgets adapt independently to the Home and Lock Screen. The release combines transparent review-before-save safeguards, focused study blocks built from real deadlines, accessible Dynamic Type and RTL layouts, and localized product and store experiences across 17 key student markets.
featuringNominationProposal.helpfulDetails: Built by an independent developer focused on reducing semester overwhelm. The update pairs review-before-save OCR with real System, Light, and Dark support, native WidgetKit views, on-device planning data, Dynamic Type and RTL QA, and localized iPhone and iPad product pages. The seasonal event asks students to complete a concrete first-week setup goal rather than promoting general app awareness.
